name: tao-automl

required.name: model
required.description: A TAO network skill with train defaults and AutoML/HPO notes.

required.name: train_dataset_uri
required.description: Training dataset URI accessible from the chosen compute backend.

required.name: platform
required.description: Compute backend available through the TAO SDK, usually lepton, brev, slurm, local-docker, or kubernetes.

required.name: skill_bank_path
required.description: Path to this skill bank so AutoMLRunner can load model skills and train specs.

required.name: train_dataclass_schema
required.description: models/<network>/schemas/train.schema.json must exist and parse successfully. AutoML is not supported for a model without this generated TAO Core train schema.

optional.name: eval_dataset_uri
optional.description: Validation or evaluation dataset URI when required by the selected model skill.

optional.name: algorithm
optional.description: Customization-only AutoML search algorithm such as bayesian, hyperband, asha, bohb, llm, hybrid, or autoresearch. Default quick-start runs do not prompt for this.

optional.name: max_recommendations
optional.description: Customization-only recommendation budget. Default quick-start runs use the workflow/model default without prompting.

optional.name: automl_hyperparameters
optional.description: Customization-only list of schema parameter paths to search. Default quick-start runs use params marked automl_enabled in the generated schema.

optional.name: custom_param_ranges
optional.description: Customization-only range/option overrides validated against the generated dataclass schema.

optional.name: llm_api_key
optional.description: Required for LLM-powered AutoML algorithms if not already available in the environment.

run.description: Create a fresh timestamped AutoML runner script and launch TAO HPO through AutoMLRunner.

status.description: Inspect an existing AutoML workflow folder, runner log, PID, or SDK state for progress.

resume.description: Resume or recover an explicitly requested existing AutoML experiment.

support.description: List packaged AutoML-supported and unsupported models by reading models/automl_support.json through scripts/list_automl_support.py without scanning model folders.

description: TAO AutoML/HPO workflow for launching model-agnostic hyperparameter optimization through AutoMLRunner while grounding model-specific details in the selected model skill.
